Mod.Name: 【玩法】掌柜帮手·高级科学家 | [Gameplay] Shopkeeper's Kit: Advanced Scientist
Mod.Author: ChaosN
Mod.Description:
【玩法型：新职业，改变游戏机制】新增职业“高级科学家”（职业选择界面第 2 页），精通模组工艺。开局：机器区、空白模组制造机（附电池和一份材料）、三块随机模组。空白模组制造机每晚耗电，把电子元件、金属、线缆做成低 / 中 / 高级空白模组（可镶 1 / 2 / 3 个词条，为之后的词条提取、合成、镶嵌做准备）。职业能力：直接放在机器区里的机器每天按两天运转（设置里可关）。这是第一步，词条芯片和另外三台机器（提取、合成、镶嵌）后续加入。界面中英双语，跟随游戏语言。 掌柜帮手系列 · 作者 ChaosN · 由 Claude Code（Anthropic 的 AI 编程助手）协助开发。
[Gameplay - new profession, changes game mechanics] Adds the "Advanced Scientist" profession (page 2 of the profession screen), a module-crafting expert. Starts with a Machine Bay, the Blank Module Maker (with a battery and some materials) and three random modules. The Blank Module Maker uses power each night to turn electronic parts, metal and wire into low / mid / high grade blank modules (1 / 2 / 3 slots, ready for the upcoming affix extraction, merging and inlaying). Ability: machines placed directly in a Machine Bay run two days' worth every day (can be turned off in the settings). This is step one; affix chips and the other three machines (extract, merge, inlay) come later. UI in Chinese and English, following the game language. Part of Shopkeeper's Kit by ChaosN. Developed with assistance from Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant).
